title: Smaller Totem & Shield
description: Makes shield and totem MUCH Smaller
body:
# 🛡️ Smaller Totem & Shield
Tired of your Totem of Undying and Shield blocking your view? **Smaller Totem & Shield** makes both the **Totem** and **Shield** smaller while keeping Minecraft's vanilla style, giving you a cleaner screen and better visibility during PvP.

Whether you're playing Crystal PvP, Sword PvP, SMPs, Bedwars, or Survival, this resource pack helps you focus on your opponent instead of large off-hand items.

---

# ✨ Advantages

* 🛡️ Smaller Shield
* 💚 Smaller Totem of Undying
* 👀 More screen visibility
* 🎯 Better focus during combat
* ⚔️ Improved PvP experience
---

# ✅ Compatibility

Supports a wide range of Minecraft versions.

Works perfectly with:

* ✔️ Vanilla Minecraft
* ✔️ OptiFine
* ✔️ Sodium
* ✔️ Lunar Client
* ✔️ Badlion Client

---

# 🎮 Advantages

Having more visible screen space makes it easier to:

* 👀 Spot opponents faster
* 🎯 Keep your crosshair on target
* ⚔️ React quicker in PvP
* 🏹 Reduce screen clutter
* 💥 Enjoy a cleaner combat experience

Small changes can make a big difference when every second counts!

---

# 📥 Installation

### Method 1 (Recommended)

1. Download the resource pack.
2. Open Minecraft.
3. Go to **Options → Resource Packs**.
4. Click **Open Pack Folder**.
5. Move the downloaded `.zip` file into the folder.

   * **Do not extract the ZIP file.**
6. Return to Minecraft.
7. Select **Smaller Totem & Shield** and click **Done**.

### Method 2

Copy the `.zip` file into:

**Windows**

```
%AppData%\.minecraft\resourcepacks
```

Then enable it from **Options → Resource Packs**.
